entities.summary: Herbert James "Burt" Munro was a motorcycle racer from New Zealand, famous for setting a motorcycle speed record in the 1000cc Streamliner Modified Fuel category, at Bonneville, on 26 August 1967. This record still stands as of January 2026; Munro was 68 and was riding a 47-year-old machine when he set his last record.
